verdict.rationale: BigQuery's conversational analytics lets users create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries. That gives AI tools a declared, reusable business context to answer against, which covers only a thin slice of a governed semantic model. Dataform (transformation workflows), IAM, and lineage are adjacent features and do not constitute a semantic layer. Missing for 10: a declared metrics/dimensions/joins model, consistent use of that model across regular SQL queries and BI tools (not just AI agents), governance and versioning of semantic definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
